# 1 Samuel Chapter 6 -- The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 153r--153v | **Source Image:** 1SA_006_page_001.jpg, 1SA_006_page_002.jpg

---

**6:1** And-was [the]-ark of-YHWH in-[the]-field of-[the]-Philistines seven months.

**6:2** And-called [the]-Philistines for-the-priests and-for-the-diviners, saying, \"What shall-we-do with-[the]-ark of-YHWH? Make-known to-us with-what shall-we-send it to-its-place.\"

**6:3** And-they-said, \"If you-[are]-sending the-ark of-[the]-God of-Israel, do-not send it empty, for you-shall-surely-return to-him a-guilt-offering [*asham*]. Then you-will-be-healed, and-it-will-be-known to-you why not his-hand turns from-upon-you.\"

**6:4** And-they-said, \"What [is] the-guilt-offering which we-shall-return to-him?\" And-they-said, \"[The]-number of-[the]-lords of-[the]-Philistines -- five tumors [*ofalim*] of-gold and-five mice [*akhbarim*] of-gold, for one plague [was] to-all-of-you and-to-your-lords.

**6:5** And-you-shall-make images of-your-tumors and-images of-your-mice, the-ones-destroying the-land, and-you-shall-give to-[the]-God of-Israel glory [*kavod*]. Perhaps he-will-lighten his-hand from-upon-you and-from-upon your-gods and-from-upon your-land.

**6:6** And-why do-you-make-heavy your-hearts as-which made-heavy Egypt and-Pharaoh their-hearts? Was-it-not when he-dealt-severely with-them, and-they-sent-them-away, and-they-went?

**6:7** And-now take and-make one cart, new, and-two cows, nursing-ones, which not has-come upon-them a-yoke, and-you-shall-yoke the-cows to-the-cart, and-you-shall-return their-calves from-after-them [to] the-house.

**6:8** And-you-shall-take the-ark of-YHWH and-you-shall-set it upon the-cart, and-the-vessels of-gold which you-return to-him [as] a-guilt-offering you-shall-put in-a-box at-its-side, and-you-shall-send it and-it-shall-go.

**6:9** And-you-shall-see -- if [by the]-way of-its-border it-goes-up [to] Beth-shemesh, he did to-us this great evil; and-if not, then-we-shall-know that not his-hand touched us -- a-chance it-was to-us.\"

**6:10** And-did so the-men, and-they-took two cows, nursing-ones, and-they-yoked them to-the-cart, and-their-calves they-confined in-the-house.

**6:11** And-they-set the-ark of-YHWH upon the-cart, and the-box, and the-mice of-gold, and the-images of-their-tumors.

**6:12** And-went-straight the-cows on-the-way, on [the]-way of-Beth-shemesh; on-one highway they-went, going and-lowing, and-not they-turned-aside right or-left. And-[the]-lords of-[the]-Philistines [were]-walking after-them unto [the]-border of-Beth-shemesh.

**6:13** And-Beth-shemesh [were]-reaping [the]-wheat-harvest in-the-valley, and-they-lifted-up their-eyes and-they-saw the-ark, and-they-rejoiced to-see [it].

**6:14** And-the-cart came unto [the]-field of-Joshua the-Beth-shemeshite, and-it-stood there. And-there [was] a-great stone, and-they-split the-wood of-the-cart, and-the-cows they-offered-up [as] a-burnt-offering to-YHWH.

**6:15** And-the-Levites brought-down the-ark of-YHWH and-the-box which [was]-with it, in-which [were the]-vessels of-gold, and-they-set [them] upon the-great stone. And-[the]-men of-Beth-shemesh offered-up burnt-offerings and-they-sacrificed sacrifices on-that-day to-YHWH.

**6:16** And-[the]-five lords of-[the]-Philistines saw, and-they-returned [to] Ekron on-that-day.

**6:17** And-these [are] the-tumors of-gold which returned [the]-Philistines [as] a-guilt-offering to-YHWH: for-Ashdod one, for-Gaza one, for-Ashkelon one, for-Gath one, for-Ekron one.

**6:18** And-the-mice of-gold [were according to the]-number of-all [the]-cities of-[the]-Philistines, of-the-five lords, from-[the]-fortified city and-unto [the]-village of-the-open-field, and-unto [the]-great meadow [*abel*] upon which they-set the-ark of-YHWH, unto this day, in-[the]-field of-Joshua the-Beth-shemeshite.

**6:19** And-he-struck among-[the]-men of-Beth-shemesh, for they-looked into [the]-ark of-YHWH, and-he-struck among-the-people seventy men [fifty thousand men]. And-the-people mourned, for YHWH struck among-the-people a-striking great.

**6:20** And-said [the]-men of-Beth-shemesh, \"Who is-able to-stand before YHWH, this-God, the-holy-one? And-unto whom shall-he-go-up from-upon-us?\"

**6:21** And-they-sent messengers unto [the]-inhabitants of-Kiriath-jearim, saying, \"[The]-Philistines have-returned the-ark of-YHWH. Come-down, bring-it-up unto-you.\"

---
## EMET\\\'s Textual Notes

1. **6:4 -- *ofalim* (tumors):** Ketiv עפלים / Qere טחרים (hemorrhoids). The Leningrad Codex preserves this Ketiv-Qere, continuing the pattern from chapter 5. EMET follows the Ketiv as the written text.

2. **6:9 -- Beth-shemesh:** Lit. \"House-of-the-Sun.\" The test proposed by the Philistine priests relies on the unnatural behavior of nursing cows leaving their calves -- if the cows go toward Israelite territory despite instinct, the plague is from YHWH.

3. **6:11 -- the box (*argaz*):** This term אַרְגַּז appears only here in the Hebrew Bible. It is a hapax legomenon, likely meaning a chest or coffer placed alongside the ark.

4. **6:18 -- *abel* (meadow) vs. *even* (stone):** The Leningrad Codex reads אָבֵל (abel, \"meadow/mourning-place\"). Some manuscripts and the Qere read אֶבֶן (even, \"stone\"), harmonizing with the \"great stone\" of v. 14. EMET preserves the Ketiv reading *abel*.

5. **6:19 -- \"seventy men, fifty thousand men\":** The MT reads שִׁבְעִים אִישׁ חֲמִשִּׁים אֶלֶף אִישׁ, a notoriously difficult number. The Leningrad Codex preserves this reading. The LXX variants and Josephus give different numbers. Many scholars regard \"fifty thousand\" as a later gloss or textual corruption. The syntax is unusual -- the smaller number precedes the larger without a conjunction. EMET preserves the MT reading as found in the Leningrad Codex but brackets it to signal the difficulty.

6. **6:20 -- \"this God, the holy one\":** The Hebrew הַקָּדוֹשׁ הַזֶּה -- the adjective \"holy\" with the article is striking, emphasizing YHWH\\\'s dangerous holiness as demonstrated by the striking of those who looked into the ark.

-- EMET
